title: Dan Nathan's Apple Options Strategy Ahead Of Earnings
text:
Game Plan For The Week - Cramer's Mad Money (4/27/18) (Seeking Alpha)
On CNBC's "Options Action" , Dan Nathan spoke about an options strategy in Apple Inc. (NASDAQ: AAPL ). He noticed that the implied volatility in the name is elevated, ahead of the earnings report on May 1 and he wants to sell a strangle to profit from a potential decline in implied volatility.
Specifically, Nathan wants to buy the stock and sell the June 180 call against it. He can collect $1 for the sale of the call and he also wants to sell the June 150 put for $2. The strategy would allow him a $3 downside protection and in case the stock moves higher, his selling price would effectively be $183. © 2018 Benzinga.com.
